stories.title: Horns' Manning apologizes for 'insensitive' reaction to violent AI video
stories.summary: Texas QB Arch Manning has apologized for an "insensitive comment" about an AI-generated video that depicted coach Steve Sarkisian slapping ESPN's Holly Rowe.

stories.title: Case closed: Silver says Clippers needed 'competitive consequences'
stories.summary: NBA commissioner Adam Silver said the league looked at similar cases before taking away five first-round draft picks from the LA Clippers for circumventing salary cap rules.

stories.title: Protect College Sports Act clears first major hurdle in Senate
stories.summary: Legislation to broadly regulate college sports has cleared a first major hurdle in the Senate after the chamber voted 74-24 Tuesday to begin consideration of the Protect College Sports Act.

stories.title: No. 8 Rebels treating Kiffin's return as just 'another week'
stories.summary: Ole Miss junior Kewan Lacy and the Rebels are clearly aware of the attention that Lane Kiffin's return as LSU coach to Oxford this weekend is getting, but the home team is centering its attention "on the game plan and the game," the running back said.

stories.title: Day: Ohio State 'to make some hard decisions' after Texas collapse
stories.summary: Buckeyes coach Ryan Day said Tuesday that Ohio State's late collapse at Texas is "going to force us to make some hard decisions."
